name: Agda
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Agda -o Agda.agda

name: Rocq
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq.v

name: RocqVerify
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq.v -c Marabou.queries && rocq compile -w none -vok Rocq.v

name: Isabelle
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Isabelle -o isabelle/Isabelle.thy

name: IsabelleVerify
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Isabelle -o isabelle/Isabelle.thy && isabelle build -d vehicle-isabelle/ -d isabelle/ IsabelleTest > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo $? || echo 1

name: Marabou
run: vehicle compile queries -s spec.vcl -f MarabouQueries -o Marabou.queries/ --network andGate:fake.onnx

name: DL2Loss
run: vehicle compile loss -s spec.vcl -l DL2Loss -o DL2Loss.vcl
